record.long_description: The Kiaitre digital food scale brings precise weighing to everyday cooking and baking. Its brushed stainless steel platform and white accents suit a modern kitchen, and its slim body takes up little counter space. The scale reads weights up to 5000 grams, about 11 pounds, in steps of 1 gram or 0.04 ounces. A tare button lets you zero out a bowl or container so you can measure liquids such as water or milk on their own. The large LCD display shows grams, kilograms, pounds, ounces, and milliliters, so you can switch units when a recipe calls for something different. The scale runs on two AAA batteries, which are included, or it can be recharged by USB cable. It shows a low battery warning and an overload warning, and it switches itself off after three minutes to save power. The platform wipes clean without streaking. For the most accurate readings, place the scale on a flat surface. It is useful for portion control as well as baking.

record.description: An automatic ping pong training machine that serves balls for practice at adjustable frequencies and spin types. A ball container holds about 120 standard 40mm balls, and a catch net collects returns. The machine's position can be adjusted to suit the user.

It feeds balls at a frequency you can set, so you can match the pace of serves to your practice needs. A spin control lets you choose the rotation applied to each ball, letting you work on returns against different spins. The ball container holds approximately 120 balls of the international standard 40mm size, which means you can run long sessions without frequent refilling. A catch net is included to gather balls that are missed or returned, helping keep the training area tidy. The machine's position can be adjusted according to your preference, so you can set it up at the angle and spot that suits your practice. For best results, use balls with a diameter of 40mm (1.57 inches). This robot is a practical choice for players who want consistent, repeatable drills on their own schedule.

A measuring cap included with the unit helps you add the right amount of kernels for each batch, so results stay consistent. The machine is also designed to work with Nostalgia popcorn kits and reusable popcorn bowls, such as the theater hot air kit and the reusable bowls named in the listing.

record.meta_description: Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT Bolt GPS bike computer in Stealth Black. Turn-by-turn LED alerts, 15-hour battery, IPX7 waterproofing, and Strava route sync.

Setup runs through Wahoo's free ELEMNT Companion App, which automates pairing and manages configuration so the unit is ready to ride quickly. Shoppers seeking a supportive sandal with a stylish look will find it a practical choice.

specs.weighting: Capped hole in each pin for adding sand

record.description: A ten-pin plastic bowling set from Champion Sports for practice, kids' games, and backyard fun. Each pin has a capped hole so sand can be added for extra stability. Comes with a set-up sheet and score pad.
record.seo_title: Champion Sports Plastic Bowling Pins, 10-Pin Set
record.meta_description: Champion Sports 10-pin plastic bowling set for training, kids games, and backyard play. Includes a set-up sheet and score pad for family rounds.
record.long_description: Champion Sports brings the bowling lane home with this ten-pin set of plastic pins, suited to training sessions, school physical education classes, and family games on the lawn or in a recreation room. The set contains ten white pins, the standard count used in pro bowling, so beginners can practice with the same setup they would find at a real alley. Each pin has a capped half-inch hole that can be filled with sand to add weight, helping the pins stay upright in wind or on slightly uneven ground. The set also includes a set-up sheet for placing the pins and a score pad for keeping track of each player's results. It is designed for children and adults alike and works well for a backyard birthday party, a vacation, or a casual round of lawn bowling with the whole family.

specs.includes: Jacket, trousers, mock shirt and hat
specs.theme: Day of the Dead Señor Bones costume

record.description: Men's Day of the Dead Señor Bones fancy dress costume in black, sized large for a 42 to 44 inch chest. The set includes a jacket, trousers, a mock shirt and a hat.
record.seo_title: Smiffys Men's Day of the Dead Señor Bones Costume
record.meta_description: Smiffys men's Day of the Dead Señor Bones costume in black, size L (chest 42"-44"). Includes jacket, trousers, mock shirt and hat.
record.long_description: Dress up as Señor Bones for Day of the Dead with this men's costume from Smiffys, a fancy dress supplier with a 125-year heritage in costumes, wigs, make-up and accessories. The black set comes as a complete outfit with a jacket, trousers, a mock shirt and a hat, so the main pieces arrive together. It is sized large for a chest of 42 to 44 inches and a waist of 36 to 38 inches, with a leg inseam of 33 inches. Smiffys says its in-house safety team checks that products meet current EU and American safety standards and regulations. Each item ships in full Smiffys branded packaging. Make-up and other accessories are not included, so add them separately if you want the full look. Check the measurements against your own before ordering to get the right fit.

record.description: A full-spectrum LED light bar for fresh and saltwater tanks, with an aluminum shell and extendable mounting brackets. It offers colorful white, blue, red and green LEDs plus blue-only daylight and lunar night modes. Designed to sit on a glass or acrylic cover over a 46 to 54 inch tank.
record.seo_title: JOYHILL Full Spectrum Aquarium Light 48 inch
record.meta_description: The JOYHILL full spectrum aquarium light offers white, blue, red and green LEDs, extendable brackets, and daylight and lunar modes for 46 to 54 inch tanks.
record.long_description: The JOYHILL full spectrum aquarium light is built for fish tanks measuring 46 to 54 inches wide, and it suits both freshwater and saltwater setups. Its aluminum alloy shell is lightweight and sturdy, and it resists oxidation while helping the unit dissipate heat. The light combines white, blue, red and green LEDs in a colorful mode, with a separate blue-only mode for daylight and another for night viewing that mimics moonlight. Two extendable brackets let you rest the light on top of the tank and adjust its length to fit the opening. The package includes the light, two brackets and a 12V power supply with a 1.5 meter cable. The unit runs at 38 watts and is designed to sit over a glass or acrylic cover, not open water. Dimensions without brackets are 117.5 by 10 by 5 cm. Before adding it, many keepers do a few water changes to reduce nutrients, and the listing suggests running it eight to ten hours a day.

specs.material: High density ballistic nylon with duraguard coating
specs.warranty: Worry Free Warranty covers airline or carrier damage

record.description: A large checked suitcase with a black ballistic nylon shell and eight spinner wheels that roll smoothly in any direction. A three-position extension handle reduces wobble when walking. Includes a suiter and tie-down system for packing, and the case expands about two inches for extra room.
record.seo_title: Travelpro Platinum Magna 2 29-Inch Spinner Luggage
record.meta_description: Travelpro Platinum Magna 2 checked large black expandable spinner suitcase with 8 magnetic wheels, PowerScope handle, and a Worry Free Warranty.
record.long_description: This checked-large suitcase from Travelpro is built for longer trips. Its black shell is made from high density ballistic nylon with a duraguard coating, and reinforced zipper heads are designed to handle frequent use. Leather top and side carry handles, plus a bottom handle cup, give several ways to lift it. Eight self-aligning magnetic wheels roll smoothly in any direction, and a three-position PowerScope extension handle helps limit wobble while you walk. Inside, a deluxe suiter and tie-down system helps keep clothing organized. The case measures about 29 by 20.5 by 12.75 inches and can expand roughly two extra inches when you need more room. It weighs about 11.3 pounds and holds roughly 143.5 liters. The Worry Free Warranty covers repair costs for damage caused by an airline or other common carrier.

specs.wake_sleep: Automatic when case is opened or closed

record.description: A plum-colored full-cover case made from fabric with a soft microfiber interior to guard the screen. Opening or closing the case wakes or sleeps the tablet. A magnetic closure keeps it shut while traveling, and a slim built-in stand supports landscape or portrait viewing. Designed by Amazon for the Fire 10 7th and 9th generation tablets.
record.seo_title: Amazon Plum Fire HD 10 Tablet Case with Stand
record.meta_description: Plum fabric case for Fire HD 10 tablets from Amazon, with microfiber interior, auto wake and sleep, magnetic closure, and a built-in stand.
record.long_description: This plum Amazon case is made to fit the Fire 10 tablet, and it works only with the 7th and 9th generation models from the 2017 and 2019 releases. The fabric exterior is paired with a microfiber interior that helps protect the screen and keep it clean. Because the cover is a full wrap, it stays closed on the go while leaving buttons, ports, and cameras easy to reach. Opening the case wakes the tablet and closing it puts the tablet to sleep, so there is no separate button to press. The slim design includes a built-in stand that holds the tablet for hands-free viewing in either landscape or portrait orientation. It suits everyday reading, video, and browsing at home or away. Check your tablet's generation before buying, since older or newer Fire HD 10 models are not supported.

specs.type: Full service curbside mailbox and package drop

record.description: A curbside mailbox and package drop with a secure parcel compartment and a locking letter slot, plus an enclosed spot for outgoing mail. Built from galvanized steel and approved by USPS.
record.seo_title: dVault DVCS0015 Full Service Curbside Mailbox
record.meta_description: Secure curbside mail and package drop from dVault, with a locking letterbox, anti-pry compartments and galvanized steel build. USPS approved, made in USA.
record.long_description: The dVault DVCS0015 is a curbside drop box designed to keep deliveries safe while you are away. It has two separate secure areas: a large section for packages and oversized items, and a smaller locking slot for letters. An enclosed compartment also gives you a place to leave outgoing mail for pickup. Anti-pry dual hook locking holds the storage compartment closed, so deposited contents stay out of reach of passersby. The body is made from 16 gauge galvanized steel with durable powder coated finishes, and it uses stainless steel hinges and fasteners. The maker states the box is USPS approved and made in the USA. According to the listing, its extra large capacity can hold two or more weeks of mail and parcels, which suits people who work from home, travel often, or receive a lot of correspondence.

specs.material: Cotton blend upper, polyester filament inner fabric
specs.size: Long tunnel 11.42 x 3.94 in; short tunnel 3.94 x 3.94 in
specs.features: Collapsible, plastic rings at tunnel exits
specs.suitable_pets: Rabbits, ferrets, guinea pigs, small puppies, hamsters

record.description: A collapsible play tunnel set of three connected tunnels for small pets such as hamsters, guinea pigs, and rabbits. It has a camouflage pattern and folds flat for easy storage and carrying. Plastic rings keep the tunnel openings in shape.
record.seo_title: Rypet Small Animal Play Tunnel, Collapsible
record.meta_description: Collapsible play tunnel for hamsters, guinea pigs, rabbits, ferrets and mice. Three connected tunnels with a flexible center, easy to fold and carry.
record.long_description: Give small pets room to run with this collapsible play tunnel from Rypet. The set includes three connected tunnels: one long tunnel measuring about 11.42 inches and two short tunnels of about 3.94 inches, so several animals can explore at the same time. The outer layer is a cotton blend with a camouflage pattern and lace trim, while the inner lining is polyester filament. Plastic rings at the tunnel openings help them hold their shape. The center section is flexible, so the tunnels can be repositioned to suit different rooms. The tunnel folds flat for storage and carrying. The listing describes it as suitable for rabbits, ferrets, guinea pigs, small puppies, and hamsters, and states that the materials are non-toxic. The seller offers replacement for breakage within one week when the item is returned in its original packaging with accessories, excluding damage caused by people.

specs.overall_size: 141.1 in H x 102.4 in W x 43.3 in D
specs.screen_type: Front projection, MaxWhite 1.1 gain, black backing

record.description: Portable 136-inch tripod projector screen with a square 1:1 aspect ratio and white front-projection surface. Adjustable multi-aspect design supports indoor or outdoor use with standard UHD and HD projectors, including 4K and 3D-ready viewing. Includes a carrying bag.
record.seo_title: Elite Screens 136-inch 1:1 Tripod Projector Screen
record.meta_description: Elite Screens T136NWS1 136-inch 1:1 portable tripod projector screen with MaxWhite 1.1 gain surface, 4K and 3D ready, plus carrying bag.
record.long_description: The Elite Screens Tripod Series T136NWS1 is a portable front-projection screen with a 136-inch diagonal and a square 1:1 aspect ratio. Its viewing area measures 96 by 96 inches, and the white MaxWhite surface has a 1.1 gain and a black backing for use with standard UHD and HD projectors. The screen is rated for 4K Ultra HD and active 3D viewing and offers a 180-degree viewing angle. An auto-locking mechanism lets you set height across a wide range, and a standard keystone eliminator helps correct image distortion from tall or low projection angles. The surface is anti-mold and easy to clean, and the product is GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD GOLD certified for indoor use. The heavy-duty case is built for frequent use and comes with a carrying bag. It is not compatible with ultra or short throw projectors. The listing notes a 2-year warranty and lifetime technical support by email, web chat, or phone.

specs.care: Hand wash only; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A colorful 5-1/2-inch ceramic teapot from Appletree Design that works for brewing or as decor. Made of ceramic and dolamite, it is hand wash only and arrives gift boxed, suitable for gifting.
record.seo_title: Appletree Design Road Trip Luggage Teapot, 5-1/2-Inch
record.meta_description: Shop the Appletree Design Road Trip Luggage Teapot, a 5-1/2-inch ceramic teapot with a playful design. Gift boxed and hand wash only, ready to gift.
record.long_description: The Appletree Design Road Trip Luggage Teapot brings a playful touch to your kitchen and home decor. Featuring a Road Trip theme, it is a fun piece to display or to use for brewing. Crafted from ceramic and dolamite, it is built with an eye toward quality and durability. The teapot measures 5-1/2 inches and works both as a functional vessel and a decorative accent. Its bright, colorful look adds whimsy to shelves, counters, and tabletops alike. For care, hand washing is recommended, and the teapot should not be placed in the dishwasher. It comes gift boxed, making it a thoughtful present for a friend, a relative, or yourself. Whether you are updating your kitchen or looking for a lighthearted gift, this teapot offers charm in a compact size.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, no bleach, tumble dry low

record.description: A full-size four-piece bedding set in lime green, made from double-brushed polyester microfiber for a soft feel. It includes a fitted sheet, a flat sheet and two envelope-closure pillowcases. The fabric is wrinkle resistant and machine washable.
record.seo_title: American Home Collection Full Lime Green Sheet Set
record.meta_description: Soft brushed microfiber 4-piece full sheet set in lime green with fitted sheet, flat sheet and two pillowcases. Wrinkle resistant and easy to care for.
record.long_description: Refresh your bedroom or guest room with this full-size sheet set in lime green. Each set includes four pieces: one fitted sheet measuring 54 by 75 inches, one flat sheet measuring 81 by 96 inches, and two envelope-closure pillowcases measuring 20 by 30 inches. The sheets are made from high-strength polyester microfiber yarns that are double brushed for a soft, smooth touch. The fabric is designed to resist fading, staining, shrinking, and wrinkling, so the bedding keeps its look through regular use. The fitted sheet has a 16-inch deep pocket to fit deeper mattresses. The listing states the set is produced in a factory that follows the OEKO-TEX Standard 100 program. For care, machine wash in cold water with like colors, avoid bleach and fabric softener, and tumble dry on low or a delicate cycle.

record.description: Crayola woodless colored pencils come as a 120-count classroom pack with ten sticks in each of twelve assorted colors. Their solid pentagon shape means no sharpening and no shavings. Either end works for broad strokes or fine lines, and pressure controls blending.
record.seo_title: Crayola Woodless Colored Pencils, 120 Count Classpack
record.meta_description: Bulk pack of 120 Crayola woodless colored pencils in 12 assorted colors, with 10 of each shade. Solid sticks need no sharpening and leave no waste.
record.long_description: This classroom pack includes 120 colored pencils, with ten sticks in each of twelve assorted colors: white, grey, black, tan, violet, blue, sky blue, green, red, orange, yellow, and brown. The pencils are made of solid color rather than wood-cased leads, so sharpening produces no waste. Each stick has a pentagon shape. Users can apply broad color with the different sides of the stick or make finer lines with its edges. Adjusting hand pressure allows colors to be blended and shaded. The large count suits classrooms, group projects, and home crafting where many colors are needed at once. Because the sticks are solid, the set offers a simple way to draw, color, and layer without frequent sharpening. Each pencil supports a range of coloring styles, from wide background fills to detailed work, making the set versatile for many kinds of projects.

specs.features: Human detection, motion alerts, two-way audio, built-in AI
specs.installation: Requires existing outdoor wiring and weatherproof junction box

record.description: A weatherproof outdoor floodlight camera that streams and records in 1080p HD. Its 2,500-lumen floodlight activates on motion, and it offers human detection, two-way audio, and a loud siren. Mounts on existing outdoor wiring, with no monthly fees.
record.seo_title: eufy Security 1080p Floodlight Camera, 2500 Lumens
record.meta_description: Add 1080p live streaming, human detection, two-way audio and a 2,500-lumen floodlight to your outdoor wiring with this eufy camera. No monthly fees.
record.long_description:
This eufy Security floodlight camera turns a traditional outdoor floodlight into a security camera. It streams and records in full 1080p HD, so you can check who is at your door or property in clear detail. The built-in AI supports human detection, and motion alerts keep you informed when activity is picked up. Two-way audio lets you speak with visitors in real time from your phone.

The 2,500-lumen floodlight is designed to light up the area after dark, deterring intruders and helping the camera capture full-color footage at night. A smart siren can be triggered to sound a high-volume warning to scare off unwanted visitors. The unit is weatherproof for outdoor use.

Installation requires existing outdoor wiring and a weatherproof junction box. The camera is a one-time purchase with no monthly fees. It is not compatible with HomeBase. Check that your existing wiring and junction box meet the requirements before ordering.

specs.features: FormFit design, StayPut cleats

record.description: Black front and second-row floor liners from Husky Liners, shaped to fit 2005-2015 Toyota Tacoma Double Cab models. The FormFit design follows the vehicle's contours, and StayPut cleats help hold them in position. Made in the USA.
record.seo_title: Husky Liners 98951 Black Floor Liners for Toyota Tacoma
record.meta_description: Black WeatherBeater floor liners for front and second-row seats of 2005-2015 Toyota Tacoma Double Cab. FormFit design with StayPut cleats keeps them in place.
record.long_description: Husky Liners part 98951 brings front and second-row floor protection to 2005-2015 Toyota Tacoma Double Cab trucks. Each liner is formed to the detailed contours of the specific vehicle. The black WeatherBeater design is built from a rugged liner material that the maker describes as able to stand up to hard use. Exclusive StayPut cleats are designed to help keep the liners anchored in place, while the FormFit process aims for a precise fit. The set covers the front and 2nd seat floor areas of the cab. These liners are made in the USA. Before installing, confirm the fitment for your exact model year and cab configuration against the product listing, since the fit is specific to the Tacoma Double Cab.

record.description: A highback booster seat for older children that converts to a backless booster as your child grows. Suited to kids about 4 to 10 years old, 40 to 100 pounds, up to 57 inches tall, with EPS foam and a padded headrest.
record.seo_title: Graco TurboBooster Highback Booster Seat, Go Green
record.meta_description: Graco TurboBooster 2-in-1 highback and backless booster for kids 40 to 100 pounds, up to 57 inches tall, with EPS foam impact protection and padded headrest.
record.long_description: The Graco TurboBooster is a booster seat built to grow with an older child. It works as a highback booster or converts to a backless booster, so one seat can serve for years. It is designed for children roughly 4 to 10 years old, weighing 40 to 100 pounds and up to 57 inches tall. The seat back offers full coverage support as your child grows, helping keep them positioned comfortably. EPS energy-absorbing foam is included to help manage impact forces. A multi-layer headrest adds padding for comfort on longer rides. The manufacturer notes that the weight minimum was raised from 30 to 40 pounds to meet current industry standards, so check your child's measurements against these limits before use. Read the included instructions carefully and install the seat according to the vehicle manual. This booster suits families who want a single seat that adapts from the early booster years onward.

record.description: A solid blue two-piece bikini set with a strapless bandeau top and high-cut bottoms. Made from stretchy ribbed polyester and spandex, it has a padded wire-free bra, a cutout center, ruffle trim, and an adjustable tie back for fit.
record.seo_title: ZAFUL Women's Strapless Ribbed Bikini Set
record.meta_description: Shop the ZAFUL strapless ribbed bikini set in blue, with padded bra, cutout center, ruffle trim and adjustable tie back. Sizes S to L.
record.long_description: Pack for your next beach getaway, tropical trip, or poolside afternoon with this two-piece bandeau swimsuit from ZAFUL. The set pairs a strapless top with high-cut briefs, both made from a stretchy ribbed blend of polyester and spandex for a close, flexible fit. A padded bra adds light shape without wires, and the cutout center and ruffled frill give the design a flirty finish. An adjustable lace-up tie at the back lets you fine-tune the fit, and the natural waist sits at the classic position. The solid blue colour suits vacations, honeymoons, and everyday pool days alike. Sizes run from S (US 4) to L (US 8), and the listing advises checking bust, waist, and hip measurements before ordering, since manual measuring can vary by one to two centimetres.

record.description: Pair of pop-up soccer goals sized 4 by 3 feet for backyard skills practice. The frames fold down for easy carrying, and the net uses Dacron with fiberglass poles.
record.seo_title: Dimples Excel Kids Soccer Goals 4x3 ft, Set of 2
record.meta_description: Pop-up kids soccer goals from Dimples Excel: a set of two 4x3 ft folding goals with Dacron nets and fiberglass poles for backyard practice.
record.long_description: Give young players a simple way to practice at home with this set of two kids' soccer goals, each measuring 4 by 3 feet. The goals pop up quickly for a pickup game and fold back down for storage. Their light, portable build lets a child carry them to a park, playground, or school, and the folded size is listed as suitable for a small car trunk. The net uses Dacron material, which the listing describes as twice as thick and stronger than many goal nets on the market. The poles are improved fiberglass, which the maker says weighs a fourth as much as steel while offering comparable strength. The goals suit backyard skills practice, shooting drills, and casual play. Exact folded dimensions and weight are shown in the product pictures rather than in the text, so check those before buying. Overall, the set is aimed at families who want a durable, easy-to-move pair of goals for regular outdoor practice.

specs.product: Jon Reyes Signature Hollow Core Scooter Wheel

record.description: Two-tone scooter wheel from Envy Scooters, designed with Jon Reyes. Its hollow core construction reduces weight, and its 120mm diameter and 26mm urethane width give extra grip and control on varied surfaces. Compatible with Envy scooters from 2016 onward.
record.seo_title: Envy Scooters 120mm Jon Reyes Hollow Core Wheel
record.meta_description: Two-tone 120mm hollow core scooter wheel by Envy Scooters, designed with Jon Reyes. Features 26mm urethane for control, and fits Envy scooters from 2016 on.
record.long_description: This two-tone scooter wheel from Envy Scooters is the first two-tone wheel the brand has released, and it was designed in collaboration with rider Jon Reyes. Its color scheme pays tribute to his hometown of New York City, and its riding profile suits his style. The hollow core design keeps weight down while aiming for a smooth ride. At 120mm in diameter, the wheel uses 26mm wide urethane, which is wider than many standard wheels, to give the rider more control across different surfaces. The wheel is made for Envy model scooters from 2016 onward, so check your scooter's year before ordering. It suits riders who want a lighter wheel with a wider contact patch for stable, controlled riding on the street or in the park.

specs.closure: Adjustable top cinch with double zippered entrance

record.description: A see-through mesh screen that fits over a patio umbrella to keep flies and mosquitoes off your table while you dine outdoors. Two zippered entrances make it easy for you and your guests to reach the table. An adjustable cinch top helps it fit snugly, and the lightweight cover folds up for storage.
record.seo_title: IdeaWorks Umbrella Table Screen, Mesh Zippered Cover
record.meta_description: Keep flies and mosquitoes away at outdoor meals with this see-thru mesh umbrella table screen. It fits umbrellas up to 11' and folds up for easy storage.
record.long_description: Enjoy outdoor meals without the pests. This see-thru mesh screen slips over your patio umbrella and keeps flies and mosquitoes away from the food on your table. The adjustable top cinch closure lets the cover sit snugly on the umbrella, giving it a flexible fit. Two large zippered entrances give you and your guests easy access to the table from any side, so nobody has to reach awkwardly across the spread. The mesh cover is designed to fit umbrellas up to 11 feet in diameter, so it works with larger patio setups. When you are done eating, the lightweight cover comes off easily and folds down for compact storage until the next gathering. It is a simple way to keep your outdoor dining area comfortable and bug-free, whether you are hosting a big family cookout or a quiet lunch for two.

specs.type: Bunion corrector and big toe separator
specs.material: Elastic fabric with medical-grade gel separators

record.description: Beige orthopedic bunion splint meant to ease bunion discomfort and gently guide the big toe toward better alignment. Soft elastic fabric and built-in gel toe separators support the foot through the day or overnight. A heel loop helps keep it in place while sleeping.
record.seo_title: SINROBO Bunion Corrector Day Night Big Toe Splint
record.meta_description: Day and night bunion splint from SINROBO with gel toe separators and a heel loop to help keep toes aligned. Fits most US shoe sizes 6 to 11.
record.long_description: This beige bunion corrector is a non-surgical splint for people who want support for bunions, overlapping toes, or crooked hammer toes. The elastic fabric is meant to hold the foot and toe snugly while the built-in gel separators keep the toes apart and cushioned. The brand says the splint works gradually to guide the big toe back toward alignment with regular use. The breathable material is intended to follow the shape of the foot, and the gel is described as hypoallergenic. An elastic loop around the heel is designed to keep the splint from slipping off during sleep. It is made for most US foot sizes from 6 to 11. The separators can be washed and reused. Because the splint is slim, it is said to fit inside shoes without being noticed, and a sock can be worn over it for a snugger fit. It can be used at night or during everyday activity. Check with a doctor if you have a medical condition or pain that persists.

record.description: A smart wake-up light that works with Alexa and Google voice commands. It gradually brightens to simulate sunrise, offers four alarms, a 12-time snooze, and an FM radio with a sleep timer.
record.seo_title: LBell Smart Wake Up Light with Alexa and Google
record.meta_description: Smart wake-up light from LBell that works with Alexa and Google, offering sunrise simulation, 4 alarms, 12 snooze repeats, and an FM radio with sleep timer.
record.long_description: The LBell Smart Wake Up Light brings a gentler start to the day. Its sunrise simulation slowly brightens from dim red to bright yellow before the alarm sounds, and you can choose natural sounds such as ocean waves or birdsong instead of a harsh buzzer. Voice control works with Amazon Alexa and Google Home, so you can operate the light and alarm by speaking commands, with no separate hub required. The device needs a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network to connect. Four separate alarms can be set for different times on the same day, which helps when you want weekday and weekend schedules or different wake times for two people. The snooze button can be pressed up to 12 times, adding short extra sleep intervals. An FM radio stores preset stations and can wake you or play for a sleep timer between 10 and 120 minutes. A sunset fading mode and adjustable warm light levels suit reading, night light use, or winding down before bed.

specs.microphone: Built-in inline mic and remote (no volume control)

record.description: A USB-C in-ear headphone with a built-in DAC chipset that accepts both digital and analog input signals. It supports hi-res audio up to 24 bit/96 kHz, and its inline remote and microphone handle calls and track changes.
record.seo_title: TriLink USB C Earbud Headphones with Mic, Hi-Res
record.meta_description: TriLink USB-C earbuds with hi-res audio up to 24 bit/96 kHz, a built-in DAC, and an inline mic. Flat tangle-free cable and S, M, L earpads included.
record.long_description: TriLink USB-C earbud headphones are built for listeners who want a compact, comfortable way to carry music. The in-ear design uses 10mm drivers aimed at delivering solid bass. An onboard DAC chipset supports both digital and analog input signals, so the earphones work with many USB-C audio outputs. Hi-res playback handles formats up to 24 bit/96 kHz. An inline remote and microphone let you take calls and skip tracks, though the remote has no volume control. The flat cable resists tangling and is easy to keep organized. The package includes S, M, and L earpads so you can pick the fit that suits you. The listing names many compatible devices, including certain iPad Pro, MacBook, Pixel, Huawei, OnePlus, and Sony models, so check the compatibility list against your device before buying.

record.description: Two-pack of brush-on nail glue from Kiss that spreads evenly like polish and bonds artificial or natural nails in seconds. Its built-in brush allows precise application and is designed to avoid air bubbles under the nail.
record.seo_title: Kiss Brush-On Nail Glue 2 Pack
record.meta_description: Kiss Lightning Speed Brush-On Nail Glue, two-pack. Its built-in brush spreads evenly, bonds nails in seconds, and helps prevent air bubbles under the nail.
record.long_description: Kiss Brush-On Nail Glue comes as a two-pack of fast-drying adhesive made for attaching artificial and natural nails. The built-in brush lets you spread a thin, even layer across the nail, much like applying nail polish, which makes precise placement easier. Because the glue brushes on smoothly, it is intended to help prevent air pockets forming beneath the nail tip. The formula is described as bonding in seconds and offering a secure hold for false nails and nail tips. The brush gives you control around the cuticle and along the edges, so you can work carefully and neatly. It suits everyday nail enhancement at home as well as more detailed work in a salon setting. Keep the cap closed tightly between uses so the glue stays ready for your next application, and use it on clean, dry nails for the best results.

record.description: Women's running shoe from ASICS in Diva Pink and white, built for training and racing. It has a redesigned Adapt Mesh 2.0 upper, a FlyteFoam Lyte midsole, and Rearfoot GEL cushioning to absorb impact. Listed weight is 7.58 with a 19mm heel height.
record.seo_title: ASICS Women's Dynaflyte 3 Running Shoes, Diva Pink
record.meta_description: ASICS Dynaflyte 3 women's running shoe in Diva Pink/White with FlyteFoam Lyte midsole and Rearfoot GEL cushioning for training and races.
record.long_description: The ASICS Dynaflyte 3 is a women's running shoe in Diva Pink and white, designed for runners who want speed with a comfortable, supportive ride. The upper is redesigned with Adapt Mesh 2.0, a mesh fabric meant to provide support and flexibility for a secure, unrestricted fit. Underfoot, a FlyteFoam Lyte midsole is described by the brand as its lightest midsole formulation, offering continuous cushioning. Rearfoot GEL cushioning is intended to attenuate shock at heel strike and help the foot move smoothly toward midstance. The ASICS Impact Guidance System links the shoe's components to support a natural gait from heel strike to toe-off. An AHAR outsole, short for ASICS High Abrasion Rubber, is placed in high-wear areas. The listing gives a heel height of 19mm, a forefoot height of 11mm, and a weight of 7.58, and it is offered in size 8.5. The shoe suits training runs as well as longer or faster sessions.

record.description: A permanent hair color creme in the Mascarpone Creme Pl2 shade. Its nourishing, non-drip formula includes fruit oils and is designed to give bold color, including on dark hair, and it works for root touch-ups as well.
record.seo_title: Garnier Nutrisse Mascarpone Creme Pl2 Hair Color
record.meta_description: Garnier Nutrisse Ultra Color permanent hair color creme in Mascarpone Creme Pl2. Nourishing formula with avocado, olive and shea oils for bold, boosted color.

record.description: Thin, flexible 50-ohm RG-316 coaxial cable, 50 feet long, suited to ham radio, antenna builds, balun projects, and RF interconnections. Its silver-plated copper conductors and PTFE jacket aim for low signal loss up to 6 GHz. Works with SMA connectors for small pass-through runs.
record.seo_title: XRDS-RF RG-316 Coax Cable 50 ft, Brown
record.meta_description: XRDS-RF RG-316 50 ft thin flexible 50-ohm coax cable with silver-plated copper conductors and PTFE jacket, rated to 6 GHz for ham radio and antennas.
record.long_description: The XRDS-RF RG-316 coax cable comes in a 50-foot length and is built for projects where space is tight. Its outer diameter is about 0.1 inch, so it passes through small openings and bends easily, with a minimum install bend radius of 0.53 inch. The 50-ohm cable uses a stranded silver-plated copper inner conductor and a silver-plated copper braid, which the listing describes as efficient with low signal loss. A flexible PTFE (Teflon) jacket is intended for demanding conditions, including outdoor use. The listing gives a maximum frequency of 6 GHz and a VSWR of about 1.2 or lower across 0-3 GHz; detailed attenuation figures appear in the specs. The rated operating temperature runs from -55 to +200 degrees Celsius. Typical uses include ham radio, VHF and UHF links, antenna cable assemblies, baluns, and LTE or Wi-Fi setups. You can crimp SMA connectors onto either end to build custom cables. The package contains one cable.

record.description: Electric cotton candy machine in pink that turns hard candy or flossing sugar into fluffy cotton candy, producing about two to three servings per minute. Includes a 20-inch stainless steel bowl, sugar scoop, mobile cart, and clear bubble shield.

You can use hard candy or regular cotton candy flossing sugar, and the machine spins it into soft, airy webs that you collect on cones positioned above the bowl. A one-year manufacturer warranty is included, along with technical support from the brand. Because the machine ships in two separate boxes, the parts may arrive on different days. It operates only on 110V power, so check your outlet before purchase.

It is a plug-and-play design with a pre-wired T-harness and simple plug-in connections, reducing the separate wiring that typical systems need. Firmware comes preloaded, and the kit ships with the parts needed for installation, including a valet switch and zip ties. It is meant for vehicles with automatic transmissions only. Once installed, you can start the engine from your existing factory remotes by pressing the lock button three times, then put your key in the ignition to drive. Remotes are not included. Installation involves removing the steering column cover to reach the connection points, and the maker describes it as a roughly fifteen-minute job. A download link provides an installation tip sheet prepared by the company's technicians. U.S.-based technical support is available Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm Arizona time. The kit may not work in vehicles manufactured for sale outside the United States and Canada.

record.meta_description: Platinum faux silk taffeta blackout grommet curtain panel from HPD Half Price Drapes, 50 by 96 inches, with eight nickel grommets for easy hanging.
record.long_description: This single curtain panel from HPD Half Price Drapes brings a platinum finish to bedroom or living room windows. It measures 50 inches wide by 96 inches long and is made of faux silk taffeta. The panel is lined and backed with smooth off-white fabric, and the lining is designed to block most outside light, with blackout performance rated between 95 and 99.9 percent. Darker colors block more light than lighter ones, so this lighter platinum shade lets through some light. The top has eight nickel finish grommets with 1-5/8 inch openings, and a pole pocket that fits poles up to 1.5 inches in diameter, so it can be hung on a rod in several ways. Each panel arrives in its own bag to protect the fabric. The curtain is meant to be dry cleaned only. Fold lines can be steamed out with an iron or garment steamer, taking care to keep the iron off the face fabric. Use the store's measuring guide to choose the right length for your window.

record.description: Set of three measured liquor pourers that dispense a consistent 1.5 oz pour for spirits and wine. Made in the USA from BPA-free virgin plastic, they fit most standard 750ml bottles and help control portions at bars or at home.
record.seo_title: AmeriPour 3-Pack Measured Liquor Pourers, 1.5oz
record.meta_description: Three American-made measured pourers from AmeriPour, each dispensing a precise 1.5 oz shot. BPA-free virgin plastic that fits standard 750ml bottles.
record.long_description: AmeriPour measured pourers bring portion control to any bottle of spirits or wine. Each collared pourer uses three internal balls to release a consistent 1.5 oz measure, helping bartenders keep drink recipes uniform and limiting the overpouring that cuts into margins. The pack contains three pourers, made in the USA from BPA-free virgin plastic that is designed not to dissolve in alcohol. The spouts fit snugly on standard 750ml liquor and wine bottles. Because the pour is measured, they suit cocktail recipes, shot service, and tasting pours alike, and they are equally handy for a home bar where a recipe calls for an exact amount. For best results, prime the pourer before first use by running a little liquid through it. These pourers are designed for alcohol, wine, and spirits only and are not intended for other liquids.

record.long_description: This 6-inch-wide seam tape is designed to join two pieces of artificial turf, synthetic grass, or outdoor carpet without gluing the entire back side. Peel off the white film along the center, press the exposed adhesive onto the back of the turf across the seam, and the tape holds the edges together. Its non-woven fabric backing is dark green to blend with turf and adds grip, while the hot melt adhesive is rated for temperatures from about -10 C to 60 C. The tape is waterproof, weatherproof, and UV resistant, so it suits outdoor conditions as well as indoor use. It can also be combined with turf adhesive for extra hold on rough surfaces; apply the adhesive to the dull side of the tape. The roll measures 6 inches by 16.4 feet. The listing describes a 6-year warranty with a 30-day return policy.

specs.source: Wild caught krill from deep ocean water

record.description: Wild-caught krill oil supplement in 60 liquid softgels. Cold processed, with omega-3s carried in phospholipid form, and made in the USA in a GMP-certified facility. Non-GMO and gluten free.

record.long_description: NatureMyst Krill Oil comes as 60 liquid softgels, a supplement that provides omega-3 fatty acids in phospholipid form. According to the listing, the krill is wild caught in deep ocean water and cold processed using supercritical CO2 extraction, with no GMOs, artificial ingredients, fillers, binders, or preservatives. The oil is molecularly distilled to remove PCBs and dioxins, and each batch is said to be independently third-party tested for purity, label accuracy, and potency. The softgels are enteric coated and packed in a nitrogen vacuum to help limit oil oxidation. The product is made in the USA in a GMP-certified, FDA-inspected facility and is free of soy, gluten, milk, egg, corn, wheat, and peanuts. The listing also notes naturally occurring astaxanthin. Read the label and consult a healthcare professional before use, especially if you take medication or are pregnant.

Its keylock nose helps prevent snagging on slings and ropes, while the square hinge end holds a belay loop firmly in place. A slightly curved spine helps maximize the gate opening, making clipping and unclipping easier for climbers who want a dependable, low-fuss locking carabiner for everyday climbing and rope work.

record.long_description: MRM DHEA is a dietary supplement containing 50 mg of dehydroepiandrosterone per capsule, supplied as 90 Vcaps. DHEA is an endogenous steroid hormone that the adrenal glands produce, and this product uses a micronized form, which the listing says is intended to support absorption. The manufacturer states that purity is assured by HPLC testing. The label positions the supplement around hormone balance, energy, lean muscle mass, healthy aging, memory, weight management, joint health, mood, and healthy cholesterol levels. These are the maker's stated aims, not results this listing verifies. Because DHEA is a hormone, people who are pregnant, nursing, managing a medical condition, or taking medication should consult a healthcare professional before starting it. Follow the directions on the label.

specs.supported networks: 4G LTE and 3G, all major US carriers

record.description: An indoor cell phone signal booster for homes and offices that strengthens 4G LTE and 3G reception across large spaces. It adjusts its gain automatically to local signal conditions. Installation is do-it-yourself, and all needed components are included. Works with major US carriers, though some Sprint frequencies are restricted.
record.seo_title: weBoost Connect 4G Indoor Cell Phone Signal Booster
record.meta_description: Boost 4G LTE and 3G cell signal across 5,000 square feet with the weBoost Connect 4G indoor booster for home and office, compatible with major US carriers.
record.long_description: The weBoost Connect 4G is an indoor cell phone signal booster designed for homes and offices. It is rated to cover an area of up to 5,000 square feet, aiming to extend usable signal throughout a building rather than only near a window. The unit boosts 4G LTE and 3G signals by as much as 32 times, which can mean fewer dropped calls, clearer audio, and faster uploads and downloads. Its built-in smart technology senses nearby signal conditions and adjusts its gain automatically. Setup is meant to be handled by the buyer, and every component needed for installation is included in the box. The booster runs on standard household power at 110 to 240 volts AC. It is advertised as compatible with major US carriers, including AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, Sprint, Straight Talk, and U.S. Cellular. Government rules prohibit boosting one frequency used by part of the Sprint network, so some Sprint customers may see less improvement, though most still benefit.

record.description: A 1400-watt digital hot air fryer with a 3.5-quart non-stick basket for family-sized meals. It cooks with a convection fan using far less oil, offering six cooking functions, adjustable temperature and timer controls, and a cool-touch handle.

Because the fan does the crisping, you can cook with far less oil than traditional frying, which means fewer fatty calories and less splatter. Set the timer for up to 60 minutes, and the unit shuts off automatically when the cycle ends. A cool-touch handle makes it easier to lift cooked food from the basket without burning your hands. The package includes a full-color booklet with 26 healthy recipes to help you start cooking right away, from veggie chips to fish fillets and chicken tenders.

record.meta_description: Kohler K-10282-AK-CP Forte wall-mount showerhead with Katalyst air induction spray, 2.5 GPM flow, and a polished chrome finish. Resists hard water buildup.

The design blends air into the water stream, producing larger, fuller droplets that spread across the body in an even, generous flow. Rated at 2.5 gallons per minute, it balances water use with a satisfying shower feel. The spray face is engineered to shed mineral deposits, so it resists hard water buildup and wipes clean without much effort. Its polished chrome finish gives the fixture a bright, classic look that suits most bathroom styles. Installation is a straightforward wall-mount job for anyone replacing an existing showerhead. Because the unit has a single function, it keeps controls simple and daily use uncomplicated. Homeowners who want a dependable, easy-maintenance showerhead with a full-bodied spray will find this model a practical choice for everyday bathing and refreshing morning routines.

record.description: Men's black CEP recovery socks with 20-30 mmHg graduated compression to support circulation after training and during long travel. Made from 85% nylon and 15% elastane, with padded heel cushioning and a lightweight, breathable knit.

record.meta_description: Men's CEP graduated compression recovery socks in black, rated 20-30 mmHg, with padded heel cushioning for travel, work, and post-workout leg recovery.
record.long_description: Designed for men who want to support their legs before and after demanding days, these CEP recovery socks use graduated compression rated 20-30 mmHg, with the compression profile shaped to support venous blood return. The compression is intended to help ease the swelling and heaviness that can follow long runs, cycling, or other intense training. Padded cushioning at the heel and Achilles adds comfort for all-day wear, making them a practical choice for long flights, road trips, or workdays spent on your feet or seated. The knit is a blend of 85% polyamide (nylon) and 15% elastane, which gives a snug, stretchy fit. The fabric is lightweight and breathable to help keep skin dry during wear. CEP positions these socks as a recovery option for athletes and for people managing leg discomfort, and notes that compression can be useful during long periods of inactivity such as flying. These are not a medical treatment, so check with a healthcare provider about compression if you have a medical condition.

An offset handle places the thumb grip higher than the finger grip, which is meant to keep the elbow in a lower, more natural position and reduce wrist and thumb strain during long sessions. The relaxed silhouette drapes easily over the body. Distressed screen-printed graphics on the center chest and down the sleeve are soft and flexible, so they move with the fabric and add a vintage touch. LUX designs its jewelry in New York City, and the pieces are manufactured in China. The company states that the jewelry is lead and nickel free and compliant with U.S. requirements, which many shoppers look for when buying for themselves or others. It arrives packaged as a gift, making it a simple option for special occasions and gift-giving. The brand offers a 30-day money back guarantee and customer support, so buyers can message the seller if a problem arises with their purchase.

record.meta_description: Compact stainless steel espresso machine with a 15 bar pump, 1450W power and adjustable steam wand for frothing cappuccino and latte foam at home.
record.long_description: This MICHELANGELO espresso machine brings café-style drinks to a small counter. A 15 bar pump and 1450W power preheat the unit and pull a shot of espresso in about a minute. The semi-automatic controls include a mode knob and programmed buttons for single or double shots. An adjustable steam wand lets you froth milk for creamy cappuccinos and lattes. A portafilter comes with two dual-wall filter baskets, and a double-cup splitter lets you brew two cups at once. The body is stainless steel with a sleek profile and a narrow footprint of about 5.5 inches, so it fits into most kitchens or offices without crowding the work surface. It is a simple, entry-level option for anyone who wants espresso drinks at home without a complicated setup.

specs.package contents: Posture corrector and USB charging cable

record.description: A wearable posture corrector for women and children that uses a motion sensor to detect slouching and gives a vibration reminder to sit or stand up straight. It has an adjustable soft nylon harness and an LED display that counts correction events.
record.seo_title: Hiroumer Smart Posture Corrector with Vibration Reminder
record.meta_description: Hiroumer smart posture corrector with a sensor that vibrates when you slouch, an LED counter, and an adjustable nylon harness for users from 15kg to 100kg.
record.long_description: The Hiroumer posture corrector is a wearable reminder designed to help users break habits of hunching and rounded shoulders. Instead of pulling the body into position with a rigid strap, it uses an onboard acceleration sensor to detect when the back bends forward beyond a set angle or when the shoulders tilt abnormally, then gives a gentle vibration to prompt correction. An LED display shows the number of correction events and the remaining battery level, so you can see your progress over time. The harness is made of soft, breathable nylon and adjusts to a comfortable length. The device is powered by a small rechargeable battery that charges through a standard V8 USB port in about two hours. It is rated for users weighing between 15kg and 100kg, and the package includes the corrector and a USB charging cable. If the unit does not power on, the listing advises charging it for ten minutes before contacting the seller for support. This product is intended as a training aid for everyday posture habits and is not presented as a medical treatment.

record.meta_description: Shop TUL retractable gel pens with a 0.7 mm bullet tip and assorted bright ink colors. This pack of eight offers smooth, skip-free writing for everyday notes.

Each pen has a 0.7 mm bullet tip that lays down bold, easy-to-read lines, and the gel ink is designed to write smoothly without skipping. The assorted bright ink colors make it simple to build a color-coded note system, so key details stand out on the page when you need to find them. A metal tip adds balance and precision to each stroke, while the rubberized grip sits comfortably in the hand. The gray barrels retract the tip so it stays covered and protected in a bag or pocket between uses. Whether you are taking class notes, planning your week, or filling out forms at work, this pack gives you a dependable pen in every color you need for everyday writing at home, school, or the office.

record.description: A square propane fire pit with a hammered bronze finish, equipped with piezo ignition and a stainless steel lid. Includes a CSA regulator, hose, and fire glass, with thermocouple and anti-tilt safety devices.

record.meta_description: Shop the Hiland GSF-PR-PC square propane fire pit in hammered bronze. It has piezo ignition, a stainless steel lid, fire glass, and safety devices included.
record.long_description: The Hiland GSF-PR-PC is a square propane fire pit finished in hammered bronze. It runs on a standard 20 lb propane tank, which is not included, and is rated in the listing at 42,000 BTU in the title and 40,000 BTU in the bullet points. An external integrated piezo igniter lights the burner at the push of a button, so no matches are needed. The package includes a stainless steel lid, a CSA-approved regulator and hose, and fire glass for the burner pan. Safety features include a thermocouple that shuts off gas if the flame goes out and an anti-tilt device that cuts the gas supply if the unit is knocked over. The fire pit suits patios, decks, and backyard gatherings where an easy-to-start, low-maintenance flame is wanted. Because the listing gives two BTU figures, confirm the output with the manufacturer before relying on a specific heat rating.

If your household has more than one dog, you can add as many RX-10 collars as you need to a Humane Contain X-10 fence to contain any number of dogs. It suits owners who want a single collar that works across several setups, without buying separate collars for each system they use.

record.meta_description: Luminex by PowerSpa 24-setting shower head and handheld combo with 7 LED colors powered by running water. No batteries needed, with a 1-year US warranty.
record.long_description: This Luminex by PowerSpa shower combo pairs a color-changing LED showerhead with a handheld shower, so you can use either one alone or both together. Each head offers four settings: Rain, Massage, Rain with Massage, and a water-saving Pause mode, and both are angle-adjustable. The LED lights cycle through seven colors every few seconds, blending smoothly from one to the next, and they run on the water flow itself, so no batteries are needed. Air-injection nozzles are designed to boost water pressure output, and the 48 elastic nozzles are rub-clean to help resist clogging. The handheld unit lifts off the overhead bracket for close-up use. A patented three-way water diverter with an anti-swivel lock nut is included. The extra-flexible 5-foot stainless steel hose has solid brass conical nuts that hand-tighten without tools, and the setup connects to a standard overhead shower arm in minutes. The product carries a limited one-year warranty with US-based customer service.

record.description: Men's analog sport watch from Casio with a resin case and band, a day and date display, and a Japanese quartz movement. Rated water resistant to 100 meters, suited to swimming and snorkeling but not scuba diving.
record.seo_title: Casio Men's MRW200H-3BV Dive-Style Sport Watch
record.meta_description: Casio men's MRW200H-3BV sport watch with a 43 mm resin case, analog day/date display, Japanese quartz movement, and 100 m water resistance for swimming.
record.long_description: This Casio men's dive-style sport watch pairs a 43 mm resin case with a matching resin band that fastens with a buckle. The analog face shows three hands and a day and date window, and a mineral crystal dial window protects the display. Inside is a Japanese quartz movement powered by an SR626SW battery, which the listing estimates lasts about three years. Accuracy is rated at plus or minus 20 seconds per month. The watch is water resistant to 100 meters (330 feet), making it suitable for swimming and snorkeling. It is not intended for scuba diving. Some models include a 12/24 hour index. Its lightweight resin construction keeps it comfortable on the wrist, and the clean layout makes the time easy to read at a glance during daily wear, casual outings, and water activities.

record.description: Mini-Fit Jr. two-pin black connector kit from Molex with crimp terminals for 18 to 24 AWG wire. Includes male and female housings plus extra pins and sockets on strip-reel packaging. Rated for up to 9.0 amps per contact and operating temperatures from -40 to +105 degrees Celsius.
record.seo_title: Molex 2-Pin Black Mini-Fit Jr. Connector Kit
record.meta_description: Molex Mini-Fit Jr. 2-pin black connector kit with crimp terminals for 18-24 AWG wire, rated 9.0A per contact and -40°C to +105°C operating range.
record.long_description: This Molex Mini-Fit Jr. kit provides a set of two-circuit black connectors for wiring projects. The package includes male and female housings along with crimp pins and sockets sized for 18 to 24 AWG wire, so spare contacts are on hand during assembly. The terminals are made of brass with tin plating and come on strip and reel packaging, which keeps the contacts attached to the strip for easier handling. Each contact is rated for up to 9.0 amps and 600 volts maximum. The connectors are specified for operation from minus 40 to plus 105 degrees Celsius. The housings are made of polyamide and carry a UL 94 V-2 flammability rating. The accepted wire insulation diameter is 1.30 to 3.10 millimeters. The pitch at both the mating and termination interfaces is 4.20 millimeters, or 0.0165 inch. The kit is offered as three completed sets, which suits builders who need several connector pairs at once.

A spring-steel money clip sits on the side for cash, cards, or business cards. The RFID-blocking construction is meant to help keep credit cards, debit cards, passports, and driver licenses shielded from thieves' scanning devices. Because the wallet is compact and lightweight, it slides easily into a front pocket and stays comfortable through the day. The black finish keeps the look simple. Each wallet comes in gift box packaging, which makes it a practical present for yourself or someone you care about.

By day it reads as a plain black sports jacket, but under headlights and other lights it reflects a bright rainbow pattern. The lightweight reflective fabric covers the jacket on all sides, so light from vehicles is returned toward the source and the wearer stands out from a distance. A breathable mesh liner keeps the jacket comfortable during activity. A detachable hood can be tucked into the collar when not needed, and two lower pockets provide room for small essentials. The jacket suits running, cycling, walking, and other outdoor activities in low light and varied weather. The listing states the material is CE EN 20471 certified. For care, do not wash with water; use a neutral detergent at no more than 30 degrees Celsius, wash no more than 10 times, and avoid long sun exposure.

record.long_description: The Safescan TP-230 is a thermal receipt printer built to work alongside Safescan money counters. After each count, it prints the total counting result broken down by denomination, giving you a clear paper record of the batch. It is listed as compatible with the Safescan 6165, 6185, 2885-S and 2985-SX models, so check your counter before purchase. The printer uses standard thermal print paper, so no ink or toner is needed. Its controls are straightforward, and setup is meant to be simple for everyday cash handling at a till or back office. Use it when you need a printed tally of cash counts to file, review, or hand over with your daily takings. Because it works with standard thermal rolls, replacing paper is a matter of buying common stock rather than specialty supplies. The printed totals make it easier to reconcile drawers at the end of a shift and to keep consistent records across several counting sessions.

record.seo_title: SagsAway Sagging Cushion Repair Foam Insert
record.meta_description: Fix sagging sofa, loveseat and chair seat cushions with SagsAway dense foam inserts. Slip one inside the zippered cover, cut to size, and restore comfort.
record.long_description: SagsAway is a foam repair insert for seat cushions that have lost their shape on sofas, loveseats and chairs. Instead of replacing a cushion core, you place the insert inside the existing zippered cover, where it compresses into the sagging foam and brings back firmness and a more level seat. The insert comes in two thicknesses and can be cut to fit different cushion sizes, so you can match it to how deep the sag is. Each kit repairs one cushion. The product is made in the United States. The maker recommends testing the result with one cushion first and measuring the sag as you actually sit. It works only when the cushion still has enough foam beneath the sag, usually about two inches. If the cushion foam is too weak or the spring deck is worn, the insert will not compensate, so check those conditions before you buy. Read the included instructions before use, and do not place the insert under the cushion.
