The seamless underwire design features encased wires for added comfort, and the cups are designed to reduce bust projection by up to 1.5 inches, offering a more streamlined look under blouses and sweaters. A silky lining provides a smooth feel and gentle modesty without adding extra padding, and soft embrace sides are meant to help prevent skin irritation. Lightly padded straps help ease shoulder stress during the day. The bra is tagless for comfort and fastens with a hook-and-eye closure and a back band with three hooks and three adjustment settings. The shell is 76% nylon and 24% spandex, with lining made from nylon, polyester, cotton and spandex blends. Hand washing is recommended to care for it. The bra is imported and comes in white, size 36C.

specs.material: Metal frame with removable plush mattress
specs.mounting: Nut suction cups for top-hung windows

record.description: A two-layer cat window perch with a cat-face metal frame and grey plush mattress. Its nut suction cups mount it to a glass window, giving cats a raised spot to rest and watch the outdoors.
record.seo_title: LIFIS Grey Cat Window Perch with Suction Cups
record.meta_description: Grey two-layer cat window perch from LIFIS with nut suction cups, a metal cat-face frame, and a removable plush mattress. Holds cats up to 55 lb.
record.long_description: This two-layer cat window perch from LIFIS gives your cat a high resting place by the glass. The metal frame is shaped like a cat face and is designed to be sturdy. Nut suction cups hold the perch to a top-hung window and are rated for cats up to 55 pounds. The height between the two layers can be adjusted to four settings, from 11 to 13.4 inches, so cats of different sizes can stand on the lower level and climb up easily. The plush mattress can be removed for washing by machine, and the perch takes up little interior space. The window must be at least 17.7 inches wide, and the frame sits about 0.3 inches from the glass, so very small window frames may not fit. The product carries a 12-month warranty, and the seller can be contacted with any problems.

record.description: A 9 oz toddler cup for babies 9 months and up, with a soft one-piece silicone spout valve that can be removed for cleaning. The lid stays open while drinking and covers the spout when not in use. Dishwasher safe and BPA-free.
record.seo_title: Dr. Brown's Soft-Spout Toddler Cup, 9 oz Monster Blue/Green
record.meta_description: Dr. Brown's toddler cup with a one-piece spill-proof silicone spout and attached lid. 9 oz capacity, suited to babies 9 months and up, dishwasher safe.
record.long_description: The Dr. Brown's Soft-Spout Toddler Cup holds 9 ounces (270 ml) and is recommended for babies 9 months and older. Its one-piece silicone spout valve is soft and spill-proof, designed to make sipping easy for small mouths. The valve can be removed for easy cleaning, which helps you reach every part of the cup. The attached lid stays open while your child drinks, then keeps the spout covered when the cup is not in use, so the spout stays cleaner between sips. Assembly is straightforward, and the parts are simple to take apart, rinse, and put back together after each use. The cup is dishwasher safe for convenient cleaning at the end of the day. It is made without BPA. This single cup has a blue and green monster design that many toddlers will enjoy. Because it is one cup with its own lid and spout, it is easy to pack for daycare, the car, or a walk, and it is ready to use whenever your little one wants a drink.

specs.care: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry low

record.description: Pair of linen-blend curtain panels with an open weave and natural, airy look. Semi-sheer fabric softens daylight while keeping some privacy. Nickel grommet tops make hanging simple for a classic, rustic style.
record.seo_title: H.VERSAILTEX Dove Linen Blend Curtain Panels 52x84
record.meta_description: Shop H.VERSAILTEX dove linen blend grommet curtain panels, set of 2, 52 x 84 inches. Airy semi-sheer fabric diffuses light and adds natural rustic charm.
record.long_description: These H.VERSAILTEX curtain panels bring a relaxed, natural look to living rooms, bedrooms and other spaces. Each set includes two panels made from an open weave linen blended fabric with a soft touch and a simple solid pattern in a dove shade. The semi-sheer material lets in diffused daylight while reducing glare and offering a degree of privacy, so rooms stay bright without feeling exposed. Each panel measures 52 by 84 inches and has eight nickel grommets along the top, sized to fit rods up to 1 1/4 inches in diameter. The fabric is machine washable in cold water and can be tumble dried on low. Light ironing smooths out wrinkles when needed. The panels suit a wide range of decor styles, from farmhouse and rustic to more modern interiors, and pair well with other window treatments. Check the listing for available sizes and colors before ordering, since other lengths and shades are offered by the brand.

record.description: A slim-fit dress shirt in jet black with stretch fabric that moves with you, a non-iron finish that resists wrinkles, and a spread collar suited to tie knots.
record.seo_title: Calvin Klein Men's Slim Fit Non-Iron Dress Shirt
record.meta_description: Calvin Klein men's slim fit dress shirt in jet black with stretch, non-iron fabric, spread collar and adjustable cuff for a crisp, comfortable everyday look.
record.long_description: Refresh your work wardrobe with this Calvin Klein men's dress shirt in jet black, cut in a slim fit with a tapered body and slimmer sleeves for a sleek silhouette that suits most body shapes. The stretch fabric moves with you, giving extra comfort through the day. Its non-iron finish resists wrinkles, so the shirt keeps a crisp look without ironing. The fabric is designed to wick moisture away from the body to help you stay cool and dry. A modern spread collar has tips that point outward, leaving room for tie knots of all sizes, and it can be worn with or without neckwear. Two cuff button positions allow a more customized fit. The streamlined design has no chest pocket, for a clean appearance. Sizing: 15.5-inch neck with 32-33 inch sleeve.

record.description: A 27-inch frameless curved gaming monitor with a 1800R curve and a 144Hz refresh rate for smooth motion in fast-paced games. It supports AMD FreeSync Premium, includes built-in speakers, and offers DisplayPort and HDMI connections plus an audio output.
record.seo_title: Sceptre 27" Curved 144Hz Gaming Monitor C275B-144RN
record.meta_description: Sceptre 27-inch curved gaming monitor with a 1800R curve, 144Hz refresh rate, AMD FreeSync Premium, and DisplayPort and HDMI inputs.
record.long_description: The Sceptre C275B-144RN is a 27-inch gaming monitor with a frameless design and a 1800R curved panel, shaped to fill more of your field of view. Its refresh rate reaches up to 144Hz, more than double the standard rate, so fast-moving action on screen appears more fluid. AMD FreeSync Premium support keeps motion in fast-paced games smooth. For connections, the monitor provides DisplayPort and HDMI inputs along with an audio output jack, and it includes built-in speakers. The display also offers FPS and RTS presets, custom display settings aimed at first-person shooters and real-time strategy games. The power input accepts 100 to 240 volts at 50 or 60 hertz, with a maximum draw of 1.5 amps. It suits gamers who want a large, curved screen with adaptive sync and several connection options in a black finish.

specs.outsole: Rubber-EVA with heat resistance to at least 475 F

record.description: Men's 6-inch lace-up work boot with an aluminum safety toe and waterproof full grain leather upper, made in the USA. Includes a removable polyurethane footbed and a heat-resistant rubber-EVA outsole with traction tread. Rated for electrical hazard protection under ASTM F2413-11.
record.seo_title: Irish Setter Men's 83606 6" Aluminum Toe Work Boot
record.meta_description: Irish Setter men's 6-inch aluminum toe work boot with waterproof leather and a heat-resistant outsole. Rated ASTM F2413-11 for electrical hazard.
record.long_description: Built for demanding job sites, this 6-inch lace-up work boot from Irish Setter pairs protection with everyday comfort. The upper is made from full grain leather that is waterproof and manufactured in the USA. An aluminum safety toe guards the toes, and the boot meets ASTM F2413-11 standards for electrical hazard protection, carrying the M/I/75/C/75 safety markings. A removable polyurethane footbed provides cushioning underfoot. The rubber-EVA outsole features a traction tread for grip and is heat resistant, resisting melting at a minimum of 475 degrees Fahrenheit. This brown boot is offered in size 11.5 D US. Its lace-up closure lets you adjust the fit, making it a practical choice for workers who need safety footwear in wet or hazardous environments.

specs.features: Stretch, non-iron, zipper fly with button closure
specs.pockets: Slant front pocket and rear welt pockets

record.description: Men's black stretch dress pants in a slim, skinny-through-the-thigh cut with a tapered leg. The non-iron fabric is designed to stay virtually wrinkle-free, and the zipper fly and pockets suit both office and weekend wear.
record.seo_title: Plaid&Plain Men's Stretch Dress Pants 7104 Black
record.meta_description: Black slim fit stretch dress pants from Plaid&Plain. The non-iron fabric stays virtually wrinkle-free, and the tapered leg suits work or formal events.
record.long_description: These men's dress pants bring a sleek, skinny-through-the-thigh silhouette to formal events and everyday occasions alike. The slim fit sits lower on the waist and narrows to a tapered leg opening for a streamlined look. A touch of stretch adds comfort for long days, while the non-iron fabric is designed to stay virtually wrinkle-free, so less time is spent at the ironing board. Practical details include a zipper fly with button closure, a slant pocket and rear welt pockets. The timeless design suits the office and professional settings as well as weekend wear. Finished in black, the pants come in size 27 waist by 30 length. Fabric composition and care instructions are not listed in the product information, so check the garment label before washing. The style is a good fit for shoppers who want dressy pants that still feel easy to wear.

specs.material: Organic cotton front, polyester fleece back
specs.components: Drool bibs and teething toys set

record.description: A soft white baby set with bandana drool bibs and teething toys. The bibs have an absorbent organic cotton front and a polyester fleece back, and each bib adjusts with two nickel-free snaps for babies from newborn to toddler age.
record.seo_title: Vuminbox Baby Bandana Drool Bibs and Teething Toys Set
record.meta_description: Vuminbox white baby bandana bibs and teething toys set with absorbent organic cotton, adjustable nickel-free snaps, for ages 3 to 24 months.
record.long_description: This white baby set pairs bandana drool bibs with teething toys, made for babies who drool during teething. Each bib has an absorbent front of organic cotton with a polyester fleece back. Two nickel-free snaps let you adjust the fit, and the listing gives an age range of 3 to 24 months, covering newborns through toddlers. The bibs are designed to stay put, so there is no need to chase a bib that has fallen to the floor or to add a separate attachment. The soft, unisex design suits boys and girls alike. The set is also presented as a gift for new parents, new grandparents, or a baby shower. The listing describes a newer design and offers a full refund if the buyer is not satisfied. The listing sells bibs and teething toys in 3-packs, so the set includes both.

record.description: A four-pack of Gobsmax items themed around Ryan's World. Contents and colors may vary from one pack to another, so the exact mix received is not guaranteed.
record.seo_title: Gobsmax Multi 4 Pack - Ryan's World
record.meta_description: Gobsmax Multi 4 Pack themed around Ryan's World, a set of four items. Products and colors may vary, so the exact contents of each pack can differ.
record.long_description: The Gobsmax Multi 4 Pack gathers four items in one set themed around Ryan's World. Each pack holds a mix of products, and the listing notes that both the products and their colors may vary from pack to pack. Shoppers who want a specific design should keep this variation in mind before ordering. The pack is a simple way to add several Ryan's World pieces at once, with the count of four stated in the specifications. Because the contents are not fixed, the exact items received may differ from the images or from another buyer's pack. The listing also points to a New Super Spy theme offered through Ultimate Source, which is not part of this standard four-pack listing. Review the specifications and listing details before purchasing to confirm that the count and format match your needs.

record.description: A pair of adjustable green luggage straps that help you spot your suitcase quickly on the carousel and keep bags secured in transit. One strap has a cross button and tag. A storage bag is included.
record.seo_title: CHMETE 2-Pack Green Luggage Straps for Suitcases
record.meta_description: Two adjustable green luggage straps, 72.8 and 84.6 inches long, fit 16 to 32 inch suitcases. Bright color helps you spot your bag on the carousel.
record.long_description: Keep track of your suitcase with this set of two green luggage straps from CHMETE. The bright color makes your bag easy to pick out in the airport luggage claim area and on the carousel. Each strap has a slide buckle, so you can adjust its length to fit suitcases from 16 to 32 inches. One strap measures about 72.8 inches long and the other about 84.6 inches, and both are 2 inches wide. The straps are made to be sturdy and tear-resistant, and the maker reports they held more than 90 lb of tension in testing. You can use them separately or together as a cross belt for extra hold on your luggage. One strap includes a cross button and a tag. A storage bag is included so you can keep the set together when it is not in use. These straps add a visible marker and a firm grip to your travel gear.

specs.construction: Independently pocketed coils with layered foam

record.description: A 6-inch twin-size spring mattress from Home Life, built with individually pocketed 15-gauge coils and layered foam for support. It arrives compressed and rolled for easier delivery and is advertised as squeak-free.
record.seo_title: Home Life 6-Inch Twin Size Spring Mattress
record.meta_description: Shop the Home Life 6-inch twin spring mattress with pocketed 15-gauge coils and layered foam. Ships compressed and rolled for easy delivery.
record.long_description: The Home Life 6-inch twin mattress is a spring mattress sized for twin beds. Its support core uses independently pocketed 15-gauge coils, which allow each coil to respond on its own. Layers of foam sit on top of the coils to add cushioning. The maker states the mattress is squeak-free and describes it as more comfortable than most standard 8 to 10 inch mattresses. The mattress is shipped compressed and rolled to make delivery easier. The listing identifies this version by the color Mint and the model code furMattB3260Twin. Because it is six inches thick, buyers who want a deeper profile should check the dimensions before ordering. Overall, it is a compact coil-and-foam option for a twin bed, with its comfort and noise claims coming from the manufacturer's listing.

record.description: A clear hard plastic shell that fits onto the Nintendo 2DS to guard against scratches, bumps, and dust. Cutouts keep charging, volume, and other ports reachable while the case is on.
record.seo_title: Akwox Transparent Hard Protective Case for Nintendo 2DS
record.meta_description: Clear hard plastic protective case for the Nintendo 2DS. Offers a precise fit, access to ports and charging, and shock and scratch resistance for daily use.
record.long_description: Give your Nintendo 2DS a clear layer of protection with this hard plastic case from Akwox. It is shaped to fit the 2DS closely, so the console sits snugly inside. Cutouts are placed for the charging port and the volume and microphone areas, letting you use those functions without taking the case off. The shell is made from a shock-absorbing plastic meant to resist scratches, dust, and impact from everyday handling. Installing and removing the case is quick and simple, so it is easy to put on and take off. Because the case is transparent, the look of your console stays visible. The package includes one case for the 2DS and nothing else, so check that your model matches before ordering. Keeping the console in this case helps it keep a like-new look for longer.

record.description: Replacement wheel center cap for select Toyota Tundra model years 2007 through 2015, sold as a genuine Toyota OEM part. It fits the center of the wheel and is meant to match the factory cap design. Part numbers 42603-0C051 and 42603-0C050 are listed for reference.
record.seo_title: Toyota Tundra 2007-2015 OEM Wheel Center Cap
record.meta_description: Genuine Toyota OEM replacement wheel center cap for Tundra 2007-2015, part number 42603-0C051. A direct-fit hubcap for the factory wheel hub.
record.long_description: This genuine Toyota OEM wheel center cap is made as a replacement for the Toyota Tundra in model years 2007 through 2015. It fits in the center of the wheel and is intended to restore the factory appearance when a cap is lost or damaged. The listing cites Toyota part numbers 42603-0C051 and 42603-0C050, so buyers can compare them with the part number on their old cap before ordering. As an original equipment part, it is meant to match the factory design of the cap it replaces. Check the part number and your vehicle's wheel type to confirm the correct version for your truck. The item is a wheel center cap only, not a complete wheel. Keep the old cap or its part number handy when you shop to avoid ordering the wrong variant for your model year and wheel style.

specs.features: Stain blocking, mildewcide protection

record.description: A water-based white latex primer and sealer for interior and exterior use. It blocks stains and previous colors, seals porous surfaces, and includes mildewcide to resist mildew and mold. Suited to drywall, plaster, wood, masonry and brick, including humid rooms. Supplied in a 5-gallon bucket.
record.seo_title: KILZ Premium High-Hide Latex Primer, White 5 Gallon
record.meta_description: Shop KILZ Premium High-Hide stain blocking latex primer/sealer in white, a 5-gallon bucket for interior and exterior use. Blocks stains and old colors.
record.long_description: KILZ Premium High-Hide is a water-based latex primer and sealer built to block stains and hide previous colors. Its white formula seals porous surfaces and helps create a uniform, level base for the finish coat, while filling small imperfections caused by texture and porosity differences. A mildewcide package helps resist mildew and mold, which makes it a practical choice for high-humidity spaces such as bathrooms and laundry rooms. The product bonds well to most common building materials, including drywall, plaster, woodwork, paneling, masonry and brick, and it is suited to both indoor and outdoor surfaces. It suits color changes and sealing light to medium stains. For heavy staining, the manufacturer points to KILZ Max primer instead. Coverage is roughly 300 to 400 square feet per gallon. This listing is for a 5-gallon bucket of the white version.

specs.shielding: RFID and EMF blocking front flap

record.description: Vegan leather wallet case for the Galaxy S6 in black. Its front flap includes shielding meant to help guard against RFID scanning and EMF radiation, and the case holds up to four cards plus cash. A built-in kickstand props the phone up for watching videos or reading.
record.seo_title: SafeSleeve EMF Blocking Galaxy S6 Wallet Case, Black
record.meta_description: Black vegan leather Galaxy S6 wallet case with an RFID and EMF shielding front flap, four card slots, and a built-in kickstand for hands-free viewing.
record.long_description: This black wallet case is made for the Samsung Galaxy S6 and combines a phone cover with a card holder. The front flap carries shielding that the maker says blocks RFID scanning and EMF cell phone radiation, though the level of protection is not independently verified here. Inside, the card area holds up to four credit or business cards, with room for cash and a few papers. The vegan leather exterior is free of animal products and has a polished, professional look that suits both men and women. A built-in kickstand folds out to prop the phone up for reading, video, or movies, so you can use it hands-free on a flat surface. The case is designed as a slim everyday accessory that keeps your phone, cards, and cash together in one place.

record.description: Women's running short in a Hydro Glitch Stripe print with a wide waistband, inner drawstring, and convenient inner zip pocket. Cool dry technology helps the fabric dry faster for comfort during activity. Features a 3.5 inch inseam in 2X Large.
record.seo_title: Hanes Women's Performance Run Short, 2X Large
record.meta_description: Hanes women's performance run short in Hydro Glitch Stripe, 2X Large. Cool dry technology, wide waistband with inner drawstring, and an inner zip pocket.
record.long_description: Hanes offers this women's performance run short in the Hydro Glitch Stripe print, sized 2X Large, for active days. Its cool dry technology is designed to help the fabric dry faster, so you can stay comfortable while running, training, or moving through your day. A wide waistband with an inner drawstring lets you adjust the fit to suit your shape and keep it secure. A convenient inner zip pocket gives you a place to keep small essentials close while you move. With a 3.5 inch inseam, the short offers a relaxed, practical length for workouts and warm-weather wear. It is a straightforward everyday choice for anyone who wants a functional running short with an easy-to-adjust waist and a secure pocket for small items. Check the product label for specific fabric content and care instructions before washing.

record.description: Indoor LED strip kit that shifts white light from warm 3000K to daylight 6000K across ten brightness levels. The 20-foot run carries 720 LEDs and comes with a 360-degree RF remote and a UL-listed power adapter. Self-adhesive backing plus included brackets and screws make it easy to mount under cabinets, behind a TV, or in a bedroom.
record.seo_title: Novostella 20ft Tunable White LED Strip Light Kit
record.meta_description: Novostella 20ft dimmable tunable white LED strip kit with 720 LEDs, 3000K to 6000K color range, RF remote and power adapter included for indoor use.
record.long_description: This Novostella LED strip kit brings adjustable white light to indoor spaces. The 6-meter (20-foot) flexible strip carries 720 SMD 2835 LEDs and lets you choose anywhere from warm white at 3000K to daylight at 6000K, with a neutral 4500K setting in between. Ten brightness levels let you tune the glow for tasks or relaxing evenings. The kit includes a 360-degree RF remote, which the listing says works more accurately than infrared remotes and reaches up to about 40 to 45 feet, even through walls, doors, and cabinets. The strip runs on 24V DC from a UL-listed adapter that accepts 100 to 240V AC input. The back is self-adhesive, and twelve mounting brackets with screws are included for a more secure installation. The listing describes the strip as running cool to the touch and suitable for living rooms, kitchens, under-cabinet lighting, TVs, dining rooms, bedrooms, stairways, and party decor. It is rated for indoor use only, since it is not waterproof, and the listing gives a rated lifespan of 50,000 hours.

specs.dimensions: 3-3/5 in L x 2-3/4 in W x 3-3/4 in H

record.description: A stainless steel dredge with a handle that holds up to 10 ounces of powder. Its multi-hole lid lets you dispense flour, sugar, or spices with a few shakes. Compact chrome finish for everyday kitchen use.
record.seo_title: TableCraft 10-Oz Stainless Steel Dredge, Chrome
record.meta_description: TableCraft 10-ounce stainless steel dredge with handle and multi-hole lid for sprinkling flour, sugar, and spices. Chrome finish, compact size.
record.long_description: This TableCraft dredge is made to sprinkle dry ingredients over food. The body is stainless steel and is designed to hold up to 10 ounces of powder. A handle on the dredge lets you hold it and shake it, and the lid is pierced with multiple holes so flour, sugar, and a variety of spices can pass through. The listing notes that only a few shakes are needed to dispense the contents. Its size is about 3-3/5 inches long, 2-3/4 inches wide, and 3-3/4 inches tall, so it is compact for handling in the kitchen. The finish is chrome. Because the lid design suits many types of powder, it is a practical tool for dusting ingredients during food preparation. The dredge arrives complete with its handle and lid as a single unit.

specs.self-healing: Small scratches and bubbles within 24 hours

record.description: Clear TPU screen protector designed for the Samsung Galaxy Watch Active and Active 2 at 40mm. Flexible film follows curved edges for wide coverage, resists fingerprints, and self-repairs small scratches. Installation guidance is included.
record.seo_title: UniqueMe Screen Protector for Samsung Galaxy Watch Active
record.meta_description: Clear TPU screen protectors for Samsung Galaxy Watch Active and Active 2 (40mm). Five-pack with self-healing, fingerprint-resistant coating and HD clarity.
record.long_description: Protect the display of your Samsung Galaxy Watch Active or Active 2 (40mm) with this UniqueMe clear TPU screen protector. The soft, flexible film is meant to follow curved edges so it covers the screen widely. Its finish is described as 99% HD clear, aiming to keep colors bright and details sharp. The surface coating is oleophobic, which helps resist everyday fingerprints and dust. The film is listed as self-repairing, with small scratches and bubbles said to smooth out automatically within about 24 hours. The cut-outs are described as accurate so they do not impair signal transmission. Each package includes cleaning cloths and dust removal products to help keep the screen clean before application. The listing also offers installation video and step-by-step instructions to guide you through fitting the film.

record.description: A U-shaped stainless steel towel bar that mounts to walls or cabinet doors without drilling. It hangs small and medium towels and comes with two separate hooks for robes, keys, or razors.
record.seo_title: Yosemy Stainless Steel Hand Towel Holder with 2 Hooks
record.meta_description: Wall-mounted 304 stainless steel hand towel bar with two towel hooks. Self-adhesive, no drilling needed, rated for up to 5 kg (11 lbs).
record.long_description: This wall-mounted hand towel bar gives small and medium towels a tidy place to hang beside a sink, in a bathroom, kitchen, laundry room, or RV. It is built from 304 stainless steel with a brushed finish, which the maker describes as rustproof and waterproof, so it suits humid spaces. The bar measures about 7.67 inches (19.5 cm) long and has a U-shaped profile for easy towel access. Mounting uses a self-adhesive backing rather than screws, so there is no drilling and no wall damage. The package includes one towel holder and two separate towel hooks, which can hold robes, hats, coats, keys, umbrellas, or razors. Adhesive mounting works only on clean, dry, smooth surfaces such as ceramic tile, marble, metal, or glass, not wallpaper or painted walls. The maximum load is 11 pounds (5 kg). Wait 48 hours after installation before use so the adhesive can cure fully.
